entities.summary: Dr. Annapurni Subramaniam is an astronomer and currently serves as the director of the Indian Institute of Astrophysics, Bangalore. She is also the first woman astronomer to head the institute. She works on areas like star clusters, stellar evolution and population in galaxies and Magellanic clouds.
